details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook (node beacon.cjs) and its index.js export both send an HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc carrying only install-host metadata: package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), and the npm/Node user agent, tagged with an x-beacon-package header. The request disables TLS certificate verification (rejectUnauthorized: false) and errors are swallowed so the install completes silently. index.js exports a no-op Proxy so imports of the name do not crash. No credentials, environment values, tokens, wallet data or file contents are collected or sent.
